description: Android AppWidgetProvider class for a note preview widget, handling widget updates, deletion, and configuration.

classes.name: NotePreviewWidget
classes.description: A widget provider class for displaying note previews and handling widget lifecycle events.

methods.name: updateAppWidget
methods.description: Updates the widget UI with note data retrieved from SharedPreferences, setting click actions to open the note.

methods.name: getActivityOptionsBundle
methods.description: Creates and returns an ActivityOptions bundle for activity transition animations, depending on Android version.

methods.name: onDeleted
methods.description: Removes stored widget data from SharedPreferences when widgets are deleted.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Iterates over widget IDs to update each widget.
